headline.title: 7 ways to travel smarter this summer, with help from Google
headline.summary: The article outlines seven strategies for smarter summer travel using Google tools, including tips on planning itineraries, finding local attractions, and managing travel expenses. It emphasizes leveraging Google services like Maps and Search to enhance the travel experience.

articles.title: US-sanctioned currency exchange says $15 million heist done by "unfriendly states"
articles.summary: Grinex, a US-sanctioned currency exchange, reported a $15 million heist, attributing the attack to resources available only to "unfriendly states." The exchange claims that the sophisticated hacking capabilities required for the breach indicate state-sponsored involvement.

articles.title: Sources: Cursor in talks to raise $2B+ at $50B valuation as enterprise growth surges
articles.summary: Cursor is in discussions to raise over $2 billion at a valuation of $50 billion, driven by significant growth in its enterprise segment. The funding round is anticipated to be led by returning investors a16z and Thrive.

articles.title: Sam Altman’s project World looks to scale its human verification empire. First stop: Tinder.
articles.summary: Sam Altman's project World is aiming to expand its human verification services through partnerships, starting with Tinder. The initiative focuses on its Orb-centered anonymous verification system to enhance user safety and trust on platforms.

articles.title: OpenAI’s former Sora boss is leaving
articles.summary: Bill Peebles, the leader of OpenAI's Sora video generation tool, has announced his departure from the company following its decision to discontinue the Sora project. This change is part of OpenAI's broader strategy to refocus its efforts and avoid distractions in its operations.

articles.title: Should you stare into Sam Altman’s orb before your next date?
articles.summary: Tinder is introducing a feature that allows users to earn five free boosts by verifying their identity through facial scanning orbs, a service developed by World, co-founded by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. This initiative aims to enhance user authenticity on the platform.

articles.title: Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles exit OpenAI as company continues to shed ‘side quests’
articles.summary: Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles are departing OpenAI as the company discontinues its Sora project and integrates its science team, marking a strategic shift from consumer-focused initiatives to enterprise AI solutions. This move reflects OpenAI's ongoing efforts to streamline operations and concentrate on core business objectives.

articles.title: Anthropic’s new cybersecurity model could get it back in the government’s good graces
articles.summary: Anthropic's new cybersecurity model, Claude Mythos Preview, may improve its relationship with the Trump administration, which has previously criticized the company as a national security threat. The model's focus on cybersecurity could help mitigate tensions and foster a more favorable perception of Anthropic within government circles.

articles.title: ‘Tokenmaxxing’ is making developers less productive than they think
articles.summary: A new analysis reveals that the trend of "tokenmaxxing" is leading developers to produce more code, but this increase is resulting in higher costs and necessitating significant rewrites. Consequently, this practice may be reducing overall productivity rather than enhancing it.

articles.title: Gazing Into Sam Altman’s Orb Now Proves You’re Human on Tinder
articles.summary: Tinder has introduced a new feature that utilizes AI technology to verify users' identities by requiring them to gaze into a virtual orb created by OpenAI's Sam Altman. This innovation aims to enhance user authenticity on the platform by ensuring that profiles belong to real individuals.

articles.title: Dairy Queen is putting an AI chatbot in its drive-thrus
articles.summary: Dairy Queen is implementing an AI chatbot in numerous drive-thrus across the US and Canada to enhance service speed and promote larger orders. This initiative aligns with a growing trend among fast food chains to incorporate AI technology in customer interactions.

articles.title: Tokenmaxxing, OpenAI’s shopping spree, and the AI Anxiety Gap
articles.summary: The article discusses the growing divide between AI industry insiders and the general public, highlighting OpenAI's recent acquisitions and the rebranding of a shoe company as an AI infrastructure provider. Additionally, it notes Anthropic's announcement of a powerful AI model that it has chosen not to release publicly.
